beats.text: Six signs you're growing — even when it doesn't feel like progress.
One. Things that used to excite you now quietly bore you. Your taste is outgrowing your past.
Two. You enjoy your own company more, and need the noise less.
Three. You apologise faster and defend less. Your ego's grip is loosening.
Four. You've become protective of your time, and pickier about who gets it.
Five. What once enraged you now mostly just tires you. That's perspective arriving.
Six. You feel uncomfortable a lot. Growth always does — comfort is where you were, not where you're going.
Growth is rarely loud. Usually it just feels like slowly becoming harder to knock over.
